codeFirstFindings.finding: The initial plan proposed rejecting every Unicode Character.FORMAT code point in canonical semantic payload.

codeFirstFindings.finding: Candidate compatibility trim could erase an edge control before the display-ready safety check saw it.

codeFirstFindings.finding: Legacy collapsed speech counted unsafe material candidates but contentDescription omitted their names.

codeFirstFindings.finding: Unknown or duplicate JSON member names were echoed into parser rejection prose without semantic safety/bounds.
